cues.text: Welcome to the simple machines lab. You will try levers, pulleys, a wheel and axle and a ramp. Change each machine, read the force meter, and find out what you gain and what it costs you.
First, levers. Slide the fulcrum, read the force meter, and then try some real levers. Predict before you test.
Now pulleys. Pull the rope through the force meter, and use the ruler to see how far the load rises.
The wheel and axle. Turn the well's wheel and try the two screwdrivers. Predict the force before you read the meter.
Last, the ramp. Change its length, push the crate up, and compare the force and the distance with lifting it straight up.
Prediction locked. Now run it and see what really happens.
That is not what you predicted, and that is fine. Surprises are where the learning happens. Think about why.
That is every question on every bench. Open your summary to see how your predictions and explanations went.
